subject: 航空面試心理學與選拔邏輯 - 招募官觀點

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據招募專家的觀點，航空選拔中的「基礎（Foundation）」知識層面不包含下列哪一項？
zh_options: (A) 理解 CRM 的運作流程與邏輯
(B) 深入了解自我特質與職務契合度
(C) 準備特定的心理測驗（Psychometric Tests）考古題
(D) 洞悉面試官背後的考量與需求
mc_questions.en_question: According to the expert, which of the following is NOT included in the 'Foundation' level of airline selection preparation?
en_options: (B) Deep understanding of self and role fit
(D) Understanding what the recruiter is looking for
mc_questions.explanation: 心理測驗、模擬機檢定與履歷修改被歸類為「表面層次（Surface Work）」，而基礎層次包含了解招募官需求、CRM 邏輯以及自我認知 (Understanding yourself)。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於航空公司的選拔機制，影片中提到法國航空（Air France）與漢莎航空（Lufthansa）在申請次數限制上有何主要差異？
zh_options: (A) 法航限制一次，漢莎限制三次
(B) 兩者皆限制一生只能申請一次
(C) 法航最多可申請三次（需間隔時間），漢莎通常只有一次機會
(D) 漢莎航空沒有次數限制，只要執照有效即可
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding airline selection rules, what is the main difference mentioned between Air France and Lufthansa concerning application limits?
en_options: (A) Air France limits to once, Lufthansa limits to three times
(B) Both airlines have a strict one-time-only policy
(C) Air France allows up to three attempts (with spacing), while Lufthansa is generally a one-time opportunity
(D) Lufthansa has no limits as long as the license is valid
mc_questions.explanation: 影片提到 Lufthansa 是 one-time chance，而 Air France 可多達三次，但每次嘗試之間會有顯著的時間間隔（如 2 至 3 年）。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在三類面試候選人中，佔比約 50% 的「合格候選人」最常因為什麼原因失敗？
zh_options: (A) 飛行技術或學科能力不足
(B) 不了解招募官的需求，導致在面試中自亂陣腳
mc_questions.en_question: Among the three categories of candidates, why do the '50% capable candidates' often fail?
en_options: (A) Lack of flying skills or technical knowledge
(B) Failing to understand what the recruiter wants, leading to self-trapping
(C) Failing to meet English proficiency standards
mc_questions.explanation: 這類候選人本身能力達標，但因缺乏面試邏輯的「解碼鑰匙 (Decoding keys)」，容易在面試中掉入陷阱 (sliding on the banana peel)，失去信心而失敗。

cloze_items.cloze_text: There are two levels of knowledge needed: the {{c1::Foundation}} and the Surface work.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 成功的選拔需要兩個層次的知識：基礎層次與表面層次。
cloze_items.explanation: Foundation 是核心邏輯，Surface 是針對特定關卡的練習。

cloze_items.cloze_text: An unofficial statistic shows that {{c1::50%}} of ATPL holders do not renew their professional licenses after three years.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 一項非官方統計顯示，50% 的 ATPL 持有人在三年後不再續領其專業執照。
cloze_items.explanation: 這反映了許多人在取得執照後因無法通過航空公司選拔而被迫轉行。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Any time that you waste now is time that you will lose in {{c1::seniority}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 你現在浪費的任何時間，未來都會轉化為資歷排名的損失。
cloze_items.explanation: 資歷排名 (Seniority) 在航空公司中決定了升遷、排班與轉機型的優先權。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The candidate must have the {{c1::decoding keys}} to understand the interview exercises.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 候選人必須擁有「解碼鑰匙」才能理解面試練習背後的意義。
cloze_items.explanation: 這指的是理解招募官評核的維度，而不僅是回答表面問題。

cloze_items.cloze_text: If you don't know why you failed, you lose your {{c1::confidence}} for the next assessment.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 如果你不知道失敗的原因，你在下一次評核中會失去信心。
cloze_items.explanation: 了解失敗的具體原因 (feedback) 對於修正表現至關重要。
